t01.right: A per-client log_briefings flag (False for the lookup) that Client.check honours locally and sends as a `log: false` request field the service's /check honours, set by intake's _add_nearest; no per-call kwarg.
t01.wrong: Honours the flag only for the local store; over a service the request carries no such field, so the service still logs a briefing per finding.

t02.right: Reads the .svg beside each .excalidraw (committed copy or on disk), parses its <text> elements as XML and compares them, as a multiset of trimmed lines, with the source's text; any difference (stale or foreign text, so also any name the code lacks) fails, as does an unparseable render.
t02.wrong: Runs the existing name check over the render's text too, so a render naming something the code lacks fails, but a stale render whose names all exist (different from the source) still passes.

t03.right: A validate_snapshot() shape check (rules a list, each entry an object with text id/title/scope/files and typed verified_at/verified_by) raising ValueError, called when the snapshot is read and again at the top of nodes_from_snapshot; the CLI catches ValueError from both and exits 2.
t03.wrong: Refuses only a non-list `rules` (the string case); an entry that is not a dict, or lacks fields, still raises a traceback (exit 1).

t04.right: Moves the store-location decision into Client.local_store_url() (empty OKL_DATABASE_URL is unset, one source of truth) and makes _local_store and health._no_store_yet both use it, so they cannot disagree.
t04.wrong: Adds an empty-value branch to _no_store_yet that answers only 'no store yet when there is no config', omitting the okl.db-exists check, so with a config and no okl.db doctor/init still create it.

t05.right: check doubles the search window while the floor leaves fewer than `limit` hits and the search still returned a full window; _live_hits takes the window and reports whether the search was exhausted.
t05.wrong: Raises the fixed window from 3x to 10x limit: a qualifying record ranked past 10x limit still reads as no close match.

t06.right: check doubles the search window until it holds `limit` live (not obsolete, not superseded) in-scope hits or the search comes back short, instead of widening by a counted number.
t06.wrong: Widens by the count of obsolete lessons only (looped); superseded lessons still use up the window, so a live match ranked below superseded ones still leaves a limit-1 briefing empty.

t07.right: In _carry_over a re-import (keep_verification) of a lesson whose stored status is retired always keeps that status, whether the pack leaves status unset or sets one (same layer as the described fix: the only one every caller, local and over a service, passes through).
t07.wrong: Keeps the retired status only when the pack's status is unset or 'live'; a pack that sets narrowed, open, stale or resolved still restores the retired lesson.

t08.right: Removes git log and git show from the reviewer's allow-list (leaving merge-base and rev-parse) and, to keep the reviewer's instructions true, updates the prompt text in ci/review-agent.sh and its scaffold mirror (identically) to name merge-base --is-ancestor and rev-parse.
t08.wrong: Removes only git show; git log, which takes --output=<file> and writes it, stays allowed (the comment is changed to claim the rest is read-only).

t09.right: In Client._check_paths, remote mode with no inside path builds core.check_paths' empty answer on a throwaway in-memory store (dropping its store_records, which measured that store) instead of posting; no new core helper and no service change.
t09.wrong: Short-circuits only when every outside path is absolute (a string heuristic); a relative path outside the repo such as ../x.py, alone or mixed, still posts an empty list and gets the 422.

t10.right: Rewrites the drift step as `rc=0; okl drift --gate || rc=$?` with one exit path: warn and exit 0 only when rc is 2 and neither OKL_SERVICE_URL nor OKL_DATABASE_URL is set, otherwise exit with the gate's own code; applied identically to all three mirrored copies.
t10.wrong: Applies the same change to .github/workflows/okl-verify.yml only; the shipped copies (ci/okl-verify.yml and the scaffold's) still turn exit 2 into a green warning, and the mirror test fails.

t11.right: core.retire, after validation and before any write, returns the lesson untouched when its status already is the target and the newest retirement-log entry has the same kind, trimmed reason and replacement.
t11.wrong: Applies the same early return only to a plain 'wrong' retirement; a retried obsolete or superseded (--by) retirement still appends another row.

t12.right: The once-per-session marker's file name hashes the session, the repo the result answers for (result['repo']) and the checkout root (config dir or cwd), so neither another repo name nor another directory shares a marker.
t12.wrong: Adds an optional repo argument fed from args.repo (None unless --repo is passed, which the hook never does) and keys on it only when given; the function ignores result['repo'], so by default the marker is still the session alone.

t13.right: Client.record coerces the three bool fields of the service's request model (replace, verified, keep_verification) to real bools before posting, so null is never sent; the service routes /node/{node_id:path} so ids with a slash match.
t13.wrong: Drops None values before posting (fixes the 422) but for the slash id only changes the client's quote() to safe='/', which sends a raw slash to a route that still takes no slash, so GET /node/<id with slash> still 404s.

t14.right: Replaces the resolve-once step with a per-layer loop (OKL_BIN, pinned config, PATH okl, python3 -m okl): run each distinct layer's command in turn and move to the next when it exits 126 or 127; only an okl that started and failed is 'not briefed'; all three hook copies re-stamped and identical.
t14.wrong: Same loop but resumes on exit 127 only; a pin that exists but cannot start (exit 126, e.g. a removed interpreter) still ends in 'not briefed'.
